question: List the display names of users who have posted at least one comment with a score between 1 and 5, have never received any downvotes, and also own at least one post that has more views than the average view count across all posts.

prediction.sql: SELECT u.XCL_055 FROM users AS u WHERE u.XCL_052 IN (SELECT c.XCL_010 FROM comments AS c WHERE c.XCL_007 BETWEEN 1 AND 5) AND u.XCL_062 = 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posts AS p WHERE p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052 AND p.XCL_030 > (SELECT AVG(XCL_030) FROM posts))

measures.multiplicity_argument: Single scalar subquery computing average over entire posts table

arguments.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM users u
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM comments c
    WHERE c.XCL_010 = u.XCL_052 AND c.XCL_007 BETWEEN 1 AND 5
)
AND u.XCL_062 = 0
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM posts p
    WHERE p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
      AND p.XCL_030 > (SELECT AVG(XCL_030) FROM posts)
)
